hints.title: Boundary Target Locations
hints.text: Locate the index of 1 and the index of n within the array.

hints.title: Independent Swap Distances
hints.text: Moving 1 to the front takes its index count of swaps; moving n to the end takes n minus 1 minus its index swaps.

hints.title: Crossing Path Adjustment
hints.text: If 1 appears after n, their paths cross, saving one swap.

hints.title: Index Arithmetic Formula

complexity.notes: Single pass to locate boundary values 1 and n.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations or adjacent swaps directly takes quadratic or factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Calculates swap count via mathematical indices directly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies the offset adjustment when 1 and n cross each other.
